user.title: Configure Staykey
user.description: Enter the gateway token from your Staykey dashboard (Properties > Integrations > Home Assistant) to connect this Home Assistant instance to Staykey.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Staykey
reauth_confirm.description: Staykey didn't accept this entry's gateway token. Paste the current token from your Staykey dashboard (Properties > Integrations > Home Assistant). If you haven't changed it, this prompt closes on its own once Staykey accepts the token again.

error.gateway_token_required: A gateway token is required. Copy it from your Staykey dashboard under Properties > Integrations > Home Assistant.
error.invalid_auth: Staykey didn't accept this gateway token. Copy it again from your Staykey dashboard (Properties > Integrations > Home Assistant).
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the Staykey gateway. Check your internet connection and the gateway URL, then try again.
error.token_in_use: Another Staykey entry on this Home Assistant already uses this gateway token.
error.integration_disabled: This integration is turned off in your Staykey dashboard. Turn it on there, then try again.

abort.reauth_successful: The new gateway token works. Staykey is reconnecting.
abort.reauth_retry: Staykey is trying this gateway token again. If it still isn't accepted, Home Assistant will ask again.

data_description.allow_support_actions: Lets Staykey support run debugging commands on this Home Assistant, such as reading your lock codes. Leave it off unless support asks.

error.token_in_use: Another Staykey entry on this Home Assistant already uses this gateway token.

gateway_token_required.message: This Staykey entry has no gateway token. Staykey now connects only through its gateway: copy the token from your Staykey dashboard (Properties > Integrations > Home Assistant) and add it under Configure.
